name: Mara
source:
Referred to as the "Enforcer" of the killing game, Mara is possibly even more mysterious than Headmaster Tozu. Armed to the teeth, no remorse will be shown whenever Mara needs to take action against any of the students who break the rules. Along with her towering height and "silent but deadly" attitude, fear will strike the heart of anyone that falls into her sights.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1418725364583567360]official description[/url]]
